notes: Audited every candidate: nine discovery journals and four diamond expansion journals. Four diamond routes retain verified_free; nine subscription routes remain needs_verification. Unknown means the required exclusion was not established, not that a charge was discovered.

All 13 received a complete replacement route preserving accurate original fee-evidence URLs and notes. The Elsevier author-guide evidence was upgraded from search_snippet to directly inspected page evidence; its base subscription publication fee is now none, while submission/page exceptions remain unknown.

Official Springer instructions and journal publishing pages were directly inspected for all three titles. Current publisher support warns of possible subscription page/overlength exceptions. The two Wiley instructions were directly inspected, including membership, length, color, page, and license terms.

Elsevier ScienceDirect author instructions/options and Taylor & Francis author instructions returned 403. Their indexed or general-publisher evidence is retained at its actual strength; no third-party transcription was used to certify submission/page fees. The official journal-shop pages establish that the Elsevier candidates are subscription titles.

Optional OA, print color, offprints, editing services, and content-dependent external permission fees were distinguished from mandatory standard publication costs. None of these records is a conference route; no conference registration requirement was inferred from society or conference associations.

Fee eligibility does not establish scope fit, acceptance probability, scientific validity, or permission to use AI in a particular way. Existing OSRI computational/nonclinical scope caveats remain unchanged; JEMC AI/copyright restrictions and Springer AI disclosure conditions are retained. No venue was contacted and no manuscript was submitted.
